images.title: Idli and vada hops
images.purpose: Show that idli numbers come from hops of 3 and vada numbers from hops of 5 along the counting numbers.
images.composition: One horizontal number line across the middle with teal hops drawn above it and amber hops below it, wide white space around.
images.exact_structure: One grey #6B7280 number line from 0 to 15 with 16 evenly spaced ticks; only 0, 5, 10 and 15 are numbered. Above it exactly 5 equal teal #0072B2 arcs of 3 units each, landing on 3, 6, 9, 12 and 15. Below it exactly 3 equal amber #E69F00 arcs of 5 units each, landing on 5, 10 and 15. The point 15 is a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot. Exactly 2 arc groups.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
arcs of unequal length within a group
any extra number labels on the line
images.takeaway: Idli numbers are the multiples of 3 and vada numbers are the multiples of 5.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 15 with five teal hops of 3 above and three amber hops of 5 below, both reaching 15.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the hops above and say where each teal hop lands, then do the same for the amber hops.

image_decisions.why: One clean picture carries the main idea of this concept.
